instructions: This folder holds the session replay analyzer. rrweb_analyzer.py (standard library only, apart from the public UserAction type) is a fork of an existing rrweb analyzer that now evolves in this repository; it walks the rrweb event stream (DOM recordings from the JavaScript SDK and screenshot recordings from the mobile SDKs) and produces UserAction records plus a markdown timeline. aggregators.py builds pandas summaries (clicks, rage clicks, rage taps, pauses) over those actions. Review for correct event interpretation, timestamp and ordering handling, gesture and hit-test logic, and changes to the public UserAction output. The goldens in conformance/goldens/rrweb/ pin the analyzer output for other language ports, so a behavior change must regenerate them with conformance/goldens/rrweb/generate.py. Do not ask for style refactors or docstring changes that diverge from the conventions already used in this module.
